description:
Verified numbers for one endpoint in the TradeSignal registry, measured from the requests and payments this cashier settled itself: calls, success and failure rate, p50/p95 latency, 402-to-paid conversion, paid calls, unique and repeat payers, and the daily quoted and paid price over 7 or 30 days. 0.05 USDC base (new payers 0.075, >10 payments 0.035; 1 pack call).
After: the endpoint you verified — its path is in the answer (the result's next field has the exact call).

bundle_token.description: Token from buy_signal_pack, buy_subscription (pro/desk) or buy_enterprise instead of paying per call.

endpoint.description: registry id from GET /registry, e.g. signal or regime

payer_address.description: Wallet you pay from: the payment-required error quotes your tier (0 payments +50 %, 1-10 base, >10 -30 %) and, from the third payment, an upgrade with your own spend.

payment_tx.description: Hash of a USDC transfer on Base to payTo (≥ the price, ≤ 72 h old) instead of an x402 signature.

name: registry_metrics
title: TradeSignal · registry verified metrics
